observatory: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL editorial illustration for a sophisticated blue-and-white campus learning workspace, NOT a website mockup. Main subject: a close-cropped fragment of an anonymous classical marble Atlas sculpture supporting a large armillary celestial globe; the globe and strong sculptural drapery are the focus, face small and subordinate. Medium: exquisite 18th-century copperplate engraving reinterpreted as a two-ink contemporary risograph print. Bold cobalt ultramarine #173caa and warm paper white #f8f7f2 ONLY, restrained fine halftone, crisp cut edges, strong silhouette, intricate engraved hatching defines volume rather than realistic smooth shading. Composition: panoramic horizontal plate, sculpture and spherical instrument concentrated in the RIGHT 60%, left 40% generous nearly blank warm white negative space, one fine orbital arc reaches toward left. Globe ring tilted diagonally, fragment of column at far right, clear calm composition, art book quality. No anime people, no modern mascot, no photographs, no glossy 3D render, no airbrush, no gradients, no random UI diagrams, no text, no words, no letters, no watermark, no logo. Subject must feel sculptural, physical, poetic and historically literate, contrasting classical engraving with precise contemporary geometry.
star-notes: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL editorial illustration for a simple refined blue-and-white study workspace, not a screenshot or UI mockup. Theme: a loose observatory notebook plate. Main subject: an antique star chart on the RIGHT, round astrolabe with concentric fine rings, a small crescent moon above a stack of folded astronomical folios and a single classical column fragment. A few connected stars and a small orbital construction, carefully spaced. Medium: original mid-century European scientific book illustration, single-color cobalt-blue letterpress line drawing on clean warm white uncoated paper, slightly imperfect ink contours, sparing stipple shadows, elegant calligraphic drafting geometry. More white space than blue ink, no filled dark background. Panoramic horizontal composition, almost empty LEFT 40%, objects composed loosely on RIGHT 60%, calm asymmetry, crisp readable shapes when reduced to a small 200px-tall banner, sophisticated and playful, not childish. Palette cobalt #2852b8, pale blue-gray and paper #f8f7f2. No human or mascot, no cartoon face, no words, no letters, no labels, no logo, no watermark, no modern device, no glossy render, no airbrushed shading, no mockup.
